ouroboros.contracts.v1.AuthenticatedPrin.description: AuthenticatedPrincipalRef is an identity assertion emitted by a trusted boundary.

principalId.description: principal_id is never accepted as caller identity from an untrusted body.

sessionId.description: session_id identifies the authenticated session when a session exists.

tenantId.description: tenant_id is the authenticated tenant context.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.AuthenticatedPrin.title: Authenticated Principal Ref

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.description: Identifier is an opaque, stable identifier within a declared namespace.

namespace.description: namespace prevents an identifier string from crossing a domain boundary.

value.description: value is opaque to consumers and must be non-empty after boundary validation.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.title: Identifier

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ImportRetentionPo.description:
ImportRetentionPolicy is the Stage 07 required retention selection. Every
 class must be chosen before import; missing retention fails closed at the
 boundary and never defaults raw media silently.

derivativeRetention.description: derivative_retention is the selected transcript/notes retention policy.

rawMediaRetention.description: raw_media_retention is the selected raw-media retention policy.

screenshotRetention.description: screenshot_retention is the selected screenshot retention policy.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ImportRetentionPo.title: Import Retention Policy

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ImportTranscriptR.description: ImportTranscriptRequest admits one timestamped fixture transcript.

caller.description: caller is untrusted payload identity to cross-check against authenticated context.

endedAt.description: ended_at is the visible meeting end.

idempotencyKey.description: idempotency_key distinguishes exact retries from conflicts.

partial.description: partial marks an intentionally incomplete import with usable segments.

retention.description: retention is the required pre-import retention selection.

segments.description: segments is the ordered timestamped transcript body; empty is partial only when marked.

sourceScope.description: source_scope is the explicit authorized import scope (fixture or grant label).

startedAt.description: started_at is the visible meeting start.

title.description: title is the bounded meeting title metadata.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ImportTranscriptR.title: Import Transcript Request

ouroboros.contracts.v1.TranscriptSegment.description: TranscriptSegmentInput is one client-supplied time-bounded transcript span.

endMillis.description: end_millis is exclusive within the meeting timeline.

speakerLabel.description: speaker_label is an anonymous cluster label when present; it never asserts identity.

startMillis.description: start_millis is inclusive within the meeting timeline.

text.description: text is the bounded transcript prose for the span.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.TranscriptSegment.title: Transcript Segment Input

ouroboros.contracts.v1.UntrustedMeetingC.description: UntrustedMeetingCaller carries body identity only for authenticated-context checks.

requestedPrincipal.description: requested_principal must match the authenticated peer principal and tenant.

requestedSession.description: requested_session must match the authenticated gateway session.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.UntrustedMeetingC.title: Untrusted Meeting Caller
